ebnf/case-nstar.puml.reason: A repetition count must be a decimal number; PlantUML draws n * x with the label n.

ebnf/case-tstar.puml.reason: A repetition count must be a decimal number literal; PlantUML also accepts a quoted string.

ebnf/case-two.puml.reason: PlantUML ignores text after the first semicolon of a rule line; this library diagnoses it.

envelope/after.puml.reason: PlantUML ignores text after the end marker; this library diagnoses it.

envelope/pct.puml.reason: PlantUML evaluates the preprocessor call %version() inside the JSON string; this library does not run preprocessing and refuses the line.

envelope/two.puml.reason: PlantUML draws only the first block; this library refuses a source with more than one block.

envelope/wrongend.puml.reason: PlantUML accepts any @end marker; this library requires the end marker that matches the start marker.

json/divergence-highlight-slash.puml.reason: PlantUML splits a highlight path on every '/' before it removes quotes, so "a/b" / "c" selects nothing; this library keeps '/' inside a quoted segment and selects member c of a/b.

regex/case-commaquant.puml.reason: A quantifier with two commas such as {1,2,3} is refused; PlantUML draws it as a labelled loop.

regex/case-setescape.puml.reason: PlantUML reads \- before a character in a set as a range start; this library reads an escaped hyphen.

regex/case-toobig.puml.reason: The bound exceeds the 32-bit integer range that PlantUML parses; this library refuses it instead of using -1.

regex/case-two-lines.puml.reason: PlantUML draws only the last of several pattern lines; this library refuses more than one pattern line.

regex/case-unclosedset.puml.reason: PlantUML accepts an unclosed character set; this library refuses it.

regex/case-unicode.puml.reason: PlantUML splits a surrogate pair into two drawn characters; this library keeps one code point.

regex/case-xhex.puml.reason: PlantUML reads \x41 as the class \x followed by literal 41; this library refuses \x without braces instead of guessing.

regex/doc-03.puml.reason: PlantUML draws \Q and \E as class boxes around the text; this library reads \Q...\E as quoted literal text.

regex/doc-08.puml.reason: The !option useDescriptiveNames and language settings are retained but not applied; labels keep the regex spelling.

regex/doc-09.puml.reason: The !option useDescriptiveNames and language settings are retained but not applied; labels keep the regex spelling.

regex/doc-10.puml.reason: The !option useDescriptiveNames and language settings are retained but not applied; labels keep the regex spelling.

regex/doc-18.puml.reason: The documented source has text after the end marker; this library diagnoses text outside the block.

regex/envelope-rdefine.puml.reason: Preprocessor variables, definitions and themes are not evaluated; they are refused.

regex/envelope-rtheme.puml.reason: Preprocessor variables, definitions and themes are not evaluated; they are refused.

regex/envelope-rvar.puml.reason: Preprocessor variables, definitions and themes are not evaluated; they are refused.
